name: HSN / SAC sample (56th GST Council annexures)

verification.notes: Sample headings copied from the official 56th GST Council / PIB press release annexures. Not a complete HSN or SAC list, and not a rate table. CBIC notification PDFs were not opened.

notes: HSN codes classify goods; SAC codes classify services. A code identifies the supply. The rate version, with its effective date, comes from the notification — not from the code. maps_to records the destination treatment from 22 September 2025 as described in the annexure.
